text:
incident-bot: ALERT: reserved-capacity pool 'rsv-west-2' at 99% GPU utilization for >5m. Autoscaler attempts failing (recent errors show quota ceiling). Affected tenants: OrchidBank (reserved), 2 other enterprise tenants degraded. Paging Oncall_SRE. Severity: P1 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: paging Oncall_SRE -> Kai (now) :bell:

Oncall_SRE: got it, joining. Creating incident bridge.

Kai: oncall handoff - I'm live on bridge, linking metrics dashboard: https://dash.redwood/rsv-west-2/utilization

Jess: I'm seeing queue growth on dedicated-resv scheduler: tokens_in_queue + 12k in last 10m, latency spikes for OrchidBank.

Nyla: logs show autoscaler calls returning "quota_exceeded: max_replicas reached" and also some OOMs on lower-priority batch jobs.

Support_Eng: opening customer bridge and notifying OrchidBank SREs. message -> "We are aware of degraded latency for your reserved capacity, investigating; will update every 15m."

Kai: immediate mitigation plan: 1) Evict low-priority batch sessions in rsv-west-2 2) Temporarily shift non-critical tenants to fallback region rsv-east-1 3) Patch autoscaler to bypass per-tenant soft-limit for 10m to drain queue. Any objections?

Jess: no objections. Eviction script ready, will run with `--dry-run` then actual.

Ops-East: preparing region move for non-reserved work. Notifying infra to allow cross-region routing.

Kai: running eviction now, command: ```bash
kubectl -n reserved-jobs get pods -l priority=low -o name | xargs kubectl delete --grace-period=30
```

Jess: eviction started. Deleting ~18 low-priority pods. CPU/GPU freed per kube node metrics: +6 GPUs reclaiming.

incident-bot: infra event: eviction complete (18 pods).

Nyla: autoscaler still failing: stacktrace -> ```
error: scale_up failed: cannot increase replicas for pool rsv-west-2: quota limit (max_replicas=120) reached
```

Kai: autoscaler config shows per-pool max_replicas set to 120, current in-use = 120. We have reserved tenants pinned; there are some ephemeral sessions from heavy batch tenant 'BatchForge' eating GPUs. Need targeted eviction there.

Support_Eng: pinging BatchForge contact to throttle job submissions. Support message sent: "Please pause batch runs for 15m to allow priority traffic to recover."

customer-bridge-bot: OrchidBank bridge established (https://bridge.redwood/bridge/5050012345). OrchidBank SRE on call: @orchid-sre-ops here.

Orchid-sre-ops: thanks for the update. We're seeing timeouts and degraded p99 latency. Can you confirm target mitigation?

Kai: confirmed. We're evicting non-critical batch sessions and increasing ephemeral cap for 10m while we stabilize. Expect partial recovery in ~5-8m.

Jess: running targeted eviction for BatchForge pods: ```bash
kubectl -n batchforge scale deployment/large-batch --replicas=2
```

Ops-East: routing rules updated to send new non-reserved requests to rsv-east-1 for next 20m.

Nyla: after evictions and routing change, reserved pool utilization dropped from 99% -> 88% in 7m. OrchidBank queue depth down 60%. p99 latency improving but still above SLO.

Kai: good. Next: deploy autoscaler bump patch to allow one-time burst to 135 replicas for 10m. Patch command: ```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap/autoscaler --patch '{"data":{"burst_max":"135","burst_ttl":"600"}}'
```

Jess: patch applied. Autoscaler attempted scale-up, new replicas provisioning. Watch for preemption.

incident-bot: infra event: scaled rsv-west-2 to 132 replicas (provisioner: nova-gpu-queue).

Nyla: observed several noisy-neighbor sessions with sustained >90% GPU utilization in single pods; flagged for postmortem. For now we applied graceful eviction to those pods to reduce interference.

Support_Eng: OrchidBank notified: "We've reclaimed capacity and applied short-term scaling. We expect full recovery within 20 minutes. We'll send a follow-up summary and timeline." OrchidBank: acknowledged.

Kai: monitoring. If utilization creeps above 95% again, we'll trigger tiered fallback: move OrchidBank traffic to a hot spare pool in rsv-east-1 (manual migration).

Jess: current numbers: reserved utilization 78%, p99 latency trending down, queue depth ~2.6k.

Oncall_SRE: thanks team. Documenting live mitigation steps in incident tracker ID INC-2025-0478. Add action items: 1) adjust per-pool max_replicas policy 2) implement noisy-neighbor detection + auto-evict 3) review BatchForge fairness throttles 4) communicate SLO credit to OrchidBank if SLA breached.

Kai: handoff to Night SRE (Jess) in 40min. My notes: temporary burst applied -> 132 replicas, eviction run removed 25 noisy sessions, cross-region routing relieved non-reserved ingress. Postmortem owner: Nyla.

Nyla: collecting logs for postmortem. Capturing autoscaler traces, kube events, and customer queue snapshots.

customer-bridge-bot: OrchidBank: we will provide a timeline + RCA within 48 hours. Thanks for patience.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: degraded -> mitigated. Severity downgraded to P3. Please continue monitoring; leave bridge open until handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
